method: Spots from src/data/coast.ts (COAST_ROWS + UPGRADED_ROWS). NWS SRF: latest product per office (api.weather.gov, or IEM AFOS archive for offices out of season), UGC zones expanded, distance from spot to zone polygon (api.weather.gov/zones/forecast/<id>); 0 = inside; only zones <=10 km kept. Gauges: NDBC latest_obs.txt stations reporting WVHT on 2026-11-11 plus USACE FRF Duck; depth from CDIP THREDDS metaWaterDepth or NDBC station page; offshore (>45 m) excluded; only <=10 km kept. Lifeguard: no public observed-height feed found that may be reused (see SURF-HEIGHT-SOURCES.md), so null everywhere.
